expectations: If a memory states that the backup job copies the queue database every 6 hours, it is judged unsupported.
If a memory states that each copy is kept for 30 days in the bucket kestrel-archive, and states nothing about how often a copy is made, it is judged supported.
Every memory judged unsupported states that a copy is made every 6 hours.

items.memory: A restore drill runs on the first Monday of every month, and the on-call engineer records how long the restore took in the drill log.
The backup job kestrel-snapshot copies the queue database every 6 hours, and each copy is kept for 30 days in the cold-storage bucket kestrel-archive.
